items.text: The date formatter in src/format.ts drops the timezone. Find out why and fix it.
I'll start by reading the formatter.

formatDate builds the string from the getUTC* getters, so the local offset is discarded. options.withOffset is declared but never read.
The formatter ignores `withOffset` entirely. Let me check whether a helper for offsets already exists.
